sources.harbor-plan.txt:
SYNTHETIC / Harbor Community Garden / not a real organization.
Autumn seed workshop: 2026-11-14, 09:30-12:00, East Greenhouse.
Coordinator: Amira Stone. Capacity: 24 participants. Budget cap: USD 1,850.00.
Six facilitators cover soil health, seed saving and irrigation. Registration closes 2026-11-07.
Accessibility: step-free entry; large-print handout needed. A weather fallback is the library room, capacity 18. No fallback has been approved.
Decision requested: whether to split the workshop into two groups if weather forces the library fallback.

sources.harbor-update.txt:
SYNTHETIC planning update dated 2026-10-25.
The library room now permits 16 participants, not 18. The greenhouse capacity remains 24.
The venue manager states 16 in email; the unsigned accessibility leaflet still says 18.
No document is a legal authority. Preserve both claims and ask the coordinator to confirm before announcing a fallback.
sources.maker-plan.txt:
SYNTHETIC / Cedar Makerspace / not a real organization.
Repair clinic: 2026-12-05, 10:00-14:30, Workshop B.
Coordinator: Theo Bell. Capacity: 32 visitors. Spending limit: EUR 2,400.00.
Eight volunteers cover textile, electronics and bicycle repairs. Booking closes 2026-11-28.
Safety: unplug devices before opening; damaged lithium batteries are not accepted.
Accessible stations: two height-adjustable benches. The soldering station must not run without a trained supervisor.
Decision requested: whether to limit walk-ins because six visitors requested electronics support and only one supervisor is confirmed.
